name: tpl-responded-existence-2-goal
task: If you move the ball, you must also take the key. Then pick up the box in the other room.

value.feedback: CHANGES REQUIRED: The task says "Then pick up the box in the other room," implying the box must be picked up after the key has been taken (i.e., after the blocker ball has been moved and the key acquired). The current clauses lack a precedence between `has_door_key` and `target_picked_up`. Add a hard `Precedence(has_door_key, target_picked_up)` clause to capture the intended order.

texts: The agent must eventually take the key that matches the door after the blocker ball has been moved.
The agent must eventually pick up the target box in the other room.
The agent must eventually acquire the key that matches the door.
The agent must eventually pick up the target box.
